faq.a: The mission of the Polk City Area Chamber of Commerce is to promote economic growth and development in the local community by supporting and advocating for businesses.

faq.q: What does the chamber offer members?
faq.a: Networking at the monthly luncheon and other events, ribbon cuttings, a listing in the member directory, a spot on the job board and community calendar, the Business Policy Center, and a voice when the city or state is deciding something that affects local business. The [membership page](/membership/) lists what comes with each level.

faq.q: Is the chamber part of the city?
faq.a: No. The chamber is an independent nonprofit that works alongside the city and other partners. For city business, permits, and council information, go to [polkcityia.gov](https://www.polkcityia.gov).

faq.q: Do I need to be a member to come to events?
faq.a: Most events are open to anyone. Some networking events are members only, and members pay less at the ones that cost money.
All of them. Sole proprietors working out of a spare room, trades, restaurants, banks, nonprofits, and a few larger employers.

faq.q: Does the chamber take political positions?
faq.a: The chamber advocates for local business on policy that affects local business. It does not endorse candidates or parties, and the Business Policy Center presents what changed and what it means without telling anyone how to vote.

faq.q: How do I get something on the community calendar?
faq.a: Email the details to admin@polkcitychamber.com. Community events do not have to be run by a member.
A volunteer board of directors elected by the membership, with committee volunteers handling the day-to-day work.

faq.q: Do I have to be in Polk City?
faq.a: No. The chamber covers the wider area, including Alleman, Elkhart, and Sheldahl, and plenty of members are based elsewhere in the metro and do business here.
By headcount, so a one-person business is not paying what a thirty-person employer pays. Nonprofits pay $150 at any size.

faq.q: What does referral exclusivity actually mean?
faq.a: When somebody asks the chamber who to call for what you do, you are the name given. It is the one benefit a larger chamber cannot copy, because it only works when the list is short.

faq.q: Can I come to a luncheon before I join?
faq.a: Yes. Guests are welcome at the guest rate. Come to one before you spend anything.
You get an invoice and a short form asking how you want your directory listing written. Your page is live within a week.

faq.q: Is this the same as the city?
faq.a: No. The chamber is an independent nonprofit. The city is at polkcityia.gov.
